properties.geometry_interpretation: Whole-avalanche positive outline from visible start through deposit; not a release polygon or a deposit polygon, and no absence is inferred outside it.
properties.observation_method: Manual SPOT 6 satellite-image interpretation; aval_shape=1 denotes an outline whose start through deposit was clearly and entirely visible.

scenario_inputs.source: Hafner et al. (2021) data description: approximately 100 cm new snow in 60 hours; SPOT source attribute sze.
scenario_inputs.uncertainty_statement: The 100 cm value characterizes the regional 60-hour storm, not a measured event-specific release depth; release_size is a normalized mapping of source size class 3.
